shortDescription.zh: 面向 A 股的三层 100 分制选股评分体系：基本面 / 技术面 / 资金面打分 + 21 个二级行业自适应阈值，两段式"形态预过滤 + 质量打分"选股，配套 214 个自动化测试与 Web 可视化看板。
shortDescription.en: A three-layer 100-point stock-scoring framework for A-shares: fundamental / technical / money-flow scoring with adaptive thresholds across 21 sub-industries, a two-stage selection pipeline, 214 automated tests, and a web dashboard.

shortDescription.zh: 完整建模 A 股 T+1、涨跌停、印花税、滑点等交易摩擦与凯利公式仓位管理（单票仓位约束 + 行业风险系数调整）的回测引擎，基于真实 A 股数据完成多因子策略回测验证。
shortDescription.en: A backtesting engine that fully models A-share market frictions (T+1, price limits, stamp duty, slippage) and Kelly-criterion position sizing with per-stock and per-industry risk constraints; validated multi-factor strategies on real A-share data.

title.zh: “工程 / 数据 / 认知”三大飞轮自进化系统

shortDescription.zh: 以零侵入旁路架构为量化研究流水线提供健康检查、数据质量检测与方法论复盘的自进化系统；62 个单元测试 + CI + 静态红线扫描保障工程质量，真实运行中自动检出数据缺失等问题。
shortDescription.en: A self-evolution system providing zero-intrusion sidecar health checks, data-quality detection, and methodology reviews for the quant research pipeline; 62 unit tests, CI, and static rule checks; automatically detected real data-quality issues in production.

shortDescription.zh: 人机边界协议（HABP）下的价值投资智能体研发，负责人机边界协议下财务计算与风控校验等确定性任务的规则实现。
shortDescription.en: R&D on a value-investing AI agent under a Human-AI Boundary Protocol (HABP); implemented rule-based financial computation and risk-validation modules for deterministic tasks.

title.zh: 定日镜场光学效率建模仿真

shortDescription.zh: 全国大学生数学建模竞赛（国赛备赛中）项目：实现余弦、阴影遮挡、大气透射、截断四项效率模型，采用 KD 树空间邻近搜索与 NumPy 向量化优化全场仿真性能。
shortDescription.en: CUMCM preparation project: implemented cosine, shadowing, atmospheric-transmission, and truncation efficiency models for a heliostat field, with KD-tree neighbor search and NumPy vectorization for full-field simulation performance.

title.zh: AI+工程管理：企业管理数据分析助手
title.en: AI + Engineering Management: Data Analytics Assistant for Enterprise Management

shortDescription.zh: 7 人团队 MEM 课程项目（进行中），选题方向为社保个税匹配合规分析；负责技术方案设计与数据处理、规则引擎模块开发。
shortDescription.en: Ongoing 7-member MEM course project on social-insurance and individual-income-tax compliance analytics; responsible for technical design and the data-processing / rule-engine modules.
